title: Length-guarded state update
statement: Let $g$ be a function from finite Boolean words to finite Boolean words, and let $h$ and $r$ be Boolean words. The update discards $h$, takes the first component of the pair encoded by $r$, and pairs it with either $g$ applied to the second component of $r$ (if that output's length is at most the first component's length) or the second component of $r$ itself.
hypotheses_covered: A function from Boolean words to Boolean words
caveat: The meanings of the pair encoding and its component decoders are not supplied, so the description refers to their first and second components.
